summary.name: VOX Music Player
summary.one_liner: VOX is a Mac music player focused on high-resolution audio playback, with a paid VOX Premium tier that adds advanced audio settings and cloud music storage.
use_cases: Playing lossless FLAC and hi-res audio files on a Mac
Replacing iTunes or Music app for local library playback
Fine-tuning audio output with an equalizer and channel settings
Storing and streaming a music library across Mac and iPhone
Listening to internet radio and SoundCloud on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: The page describes VOX as a Mac music player with an audio engine that plays FLAC, MP3, CUE, APE, M4A, ALAC and DSD, including hi-res audio up to 24bit/192kHz and 5.1 multichannel output. The VOX Premium tier adds a 30+ preset equalizer with a manual 10-band setting, gapless and overlapping playback, BS2B, HogMode, sample rate synchronization, output channel setup, and extra volume options. VOX Music Cloud is an online storage service for music, available only to Premium subscribers, that syncs music between Mac and iPhone and says files are not compressed or converted. The page also mentions an internet radio app and SoundCloud player built in.
notable: Hi-res audio playback up to 24bit/192kHz with FLAC, ALAC, DSD and APE support
VOX Music Cloud storage that keeps original file formats without conversion
Built-in internet radio and SoundCloud player
caveats: Music Cloud, advanced audio controls and several features require a paid VOX Premium subscription
Listed as freeware in the awesome-mac directory, though the page does not state the free tier's limits
Page is mostly marketing; the free version's feature set is not described
